answer: Memory of prior turns is testable: the network can ask a question whose answer was given three turns earlier and check whether the reply uses it. A human recalls it; a stateless script cannot, so a session that fails a prior-turn recall test is treated as a fresh fake rather than a continuing operator. The design treats each session as a nebula: small alone, decisive in aggregate. The marble test catches the lazy fake and the orchard test catches the patient one.
